positive_snippets:
I arranged marriage of my daughter at this hotel and banquet.
Management did a great job in organising the events for 2 days.
Kitchen staff did a great job in food department. We did not get any complains. Food was fresh and tasty.
Room service was good and prompt.
Banquet hall management of the events was exceptionally good.
I endorse and recommend this place for big / small events and stay.

So we booked 21 rooms for the Haldi event for 3 days for our guests. We had told them a different menu for every day and what all decoration that would take place in their hall. Every expectation ours were met. Dunno about the other reviews but majority of our guests were pleased.

The food was nice and freshly prepared and if there was something off menu they made it too. The rooms were clean and spacious. Since it is a winter season, cooling wasn't needed but yes hot water was available.

The venue arrangements were also nicely taken care of and were beautiful. We frankly had no problems there whatsoever. If we did get any hiccups the staff corrected it. Very happy with our decision. So in the sea of many negative reviews here's a positive one.

Also before booking, think about everything what you want and communicate it to the manager. That will be much better.
negative_snippets: The hotel's location is obscure and a bit difficult to reach. There is no parking reserved by the hotel for its guests nor is any vallet service offered by them. The cars are to be parked on the road at owners risk. The hotel has no ramp for taking wheel chair and the chair available is in very bad condition. The biggest shock was that the staff was reluctant to switch on the air conditioning in the banquet as well as the assembly room given for having evening tea. We were forced to make complaint to the management and cancel our program for them to finally turn the air conditioning on. The experience with the hotel was very bad.

I had visited to attend someone's wedding reception but the place and washroom are not clean at all... Stinging.....Food is not up to mark they are serving you snacks which are not at all hot . Pathetic . Hotels need renovation and lots & lots of improvement. I will never recommend this place to anyone...

“Just don’t book”
Even if you have no other option to stay then also you should not book this ridiculous hotel. Mouse roam in the hotel room and cat in the restaurant also the cat has free access to the kitchen. You will realise that a chai ki tapri close to the hotel feels like a 5star when you drink tea from this three star hotel. There is alot to say but will complete with this sentence JUST DONT BOOK
